item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a reliable 2024 source showing Hasina’s government voluntarily opened itself to independent investigation of assets, campaign finance, conflicts of interest, or concealed decisions while she was still in office. The strongest evidence is the opposite: pre-ouster repression and post-ouster probes.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says the Awami League harassed opposition and media, politicized anticorruption enforcement, and co-opted state institutions. That is strong negative evidence that independent scrutiny of conduct, conflicts of interest, and concealed decisions was not tolerated.","question_ids":["7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh repression, security-force abuses discredit elections","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/bangladesh-repression-security-force-abuses-discredit-elections","summary":"HRW reported arrests for criticism, repression of opposition, and widespread abuse ahead of the January vote. This shows a climate hostile to investigation, criticism, and outside scrutiny before the regime’s collapse.","question_ids":["7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters described internet/text shutdowns, curfew, roadblocks, and troop deployment during the protests. That is direct evidence of suppressing scrutiny rather than tolerating independent investigation of official conduct.","question_ids":["7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh crackdown left more than 170 dead, UN says","publisher":"UN OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said shutdowns increased impunity and called for impartial investigation. That strongly indicates the government was not permitting transparent inquiry into its own actions while the crisis was unfolding.","question_ids":["7B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh court orders probe into former PM Hasina’s role in grocer’s death","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 13, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-court-orders-probe-into-former-pm-hasinas-role-in-grocers-death/2221579/","summary":"This is weak counterevidence only: a court did order an investigation into Hasina’s role, but it happened after she had fled on August 5, 2024. It shows independent inquiry became possible after her exit, not that she tolerated it while in power.","question_ids":["7B.6"]},{"title":"Former Bangladesh PM Hasina demands probe into July ‘killings and vandalism’","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 13, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/former-bangladesh-pm-hasina-demands-probe-into-july-killings-and-vandalism/2222256/","summary":"This is the closest pro-accountability signal, but it is post-hoc and came after her flight from the country. It does not show she allowed independent investigation while she still controlled the state.","question_ids":["7B.6"]},{"title":"ACC begins probe into graft allegations against Hasina, family members","publisher":"BSS","date":"December 17, 2024","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news/231568","summary":"The Anti-Corruption Commission opened probes into alleged embezzlement involving Hasina, her son, sister, and niece. This is direct evidence of asset/conflict-of-interest scrutiny, but only after her rule had already collapsed, so it does not demonstrate tolerance in office.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Graft allegations: ACC seeks info on Hasina, family from CA’s office, govt agencies","publisher":"The Daily Star","date":"December 24, 2024","url":"https://www.thedailystar.net/news/corruption/news/graft-allegations-acc-seeks-info-hasina-family-cas-office-govt-agencies-3783716","summary":"The ACC sought records from multiple state bodies to investigate Hasina and her family over alleged abuses of power and project irregularities. This is strong evidence that independent review emerged only after she lost power, not evidence that she had tolerated it earlier.","question_ids":["7B.6","7B.5"]}]}
